decisions.decision: Board consensus that the NAVD 1988 vertical datum could be waived but not the NAD 1983 horizontal datum; the Applicant will pick three control points for the horizontal datum.
decisions.quote: board consensus was that the navd 1988 vertical could be waived, but not the nad 1983 horizontal. the applicant will pick three control points for the horizontal datum.

decisions.decision: Applicant to provide a plan showing buildings within 200 feet and existing driveway openings within 300 feet of the site's property lines (review letters #5 and #6).
decisions.quote: applicant will provide a plan showing buildings within 200 feet and existing driveway openings within 300 feet of the site's property lines as noted in review letter #5 and #6.

decisions.decision: Applicant to confer with the Fire Chief and then request the maximum height anticipated for the proposed radio antenna; a design for the antenna must be submitted.
decisions.quote: the applicant will confer with the fire chief and then request the maximum height they anticipate.

decisions.decision: Applicant to revise the wick drain depth (or use clean sand instead of stone) to satisfy the groundwater offset (review item #10).
Applicant to relocate stormwater contours, as the 98 contour was shown too close to Massachusetts Avenue (review item #13).
decisions.quote: the applicant will relocate contours; the 98 contour was shown too close.
